import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] gridA = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[12][12];
    static int n, T;
    static boolean[][][][][] _dp = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] reach = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] dist = new int[12][12];

    static class State {
        int tt, x, y, x0, y0;
        State(int tt, int x, int y, int x0, int y0) {
            this.tt = tt;
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.x0 = x0;
            this.y0 = y0;
        }
    }

    static void computeReach(int sx, int sy) {
        if (T >= 70) return;
        if (gridA[sx][sy] < '0' || gridA[sx][sy] > '9') return;
        Queue<State> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new State(0, sx, sy, sx, sy));
        _dp[0][sx][sy][sx][sy] = true;
        if (0 <= T) reach[sx][sy][sx][sy] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            State cur = q.poll();
            int tt = cur.tt, x = cur.x, y = cur.y, x0 = cur.x0, y0 = cur.y0;
            if (tt > T + 1) continue;
            if (tt < dist[x][y]) {
                int ntt = tt + 1;
                if (ntt > T + 1) continue;
                // same cell
                int nx = x, ny = y;
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n &&
                    gridA[nx][ny] >= '0' && gridA[nx][ny] <= '9' &&
                    !(ntt > dist[nx][ny] && dist[nx][ny] != 0) &&
                    !(ntt == dist[nx][ny] && dist[nx][ny] != 0 && (gridB[nx][ny] > '9' || gridB[nx][ny] <= '0')) &&
                    !_dp[ntt][nx][ny][x0][y0]) {
                    _dp[ntt][nx][ny][x0][y0] = true;
                    if (ntt <= T) reach[nx][ny][x0][y0] = true;
                    q.add(new State(ntt, nx, ny, x0, y0));
                }
                // neighbors
                int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
                int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    nx = x + dx[d];
                    ny = y + dy[d];
                    if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                    if (gridA[nx][ny] < '0' || gridA[nx][ny] > '9') continue;
                    if (ntt > dist[nx][ny] && dist[nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                    if (ntt == dist[nx][ny] && dist[nx][ny] != 0 && (gridB[nx][ny] > '9' || gridB[nx][ny] <= '0')) continue;
                    if (_dp[ntt][nx][ny][x0][y0]) continue;
                    _dp[ntt][nx][ny][x0][y0] = true;
                    if (ntt <= T) reach[nx][ny][x0][y0] = true;
                    q.add(new State(ntt, nx, ny, x0, y0));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> G;
    static int[][] F = new int[210][210];
    static int[] E = new int[210];
    static int[] H = new int[210];
    static int[][] C = new int[210][210];
    static int[][] nodeB = new int[12][12];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                gridA[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                gridB[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        // BFS for distances
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                dist[i][j] = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
        int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dj = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            if (dist[p[0]][p[1]] >= T) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = p[0] + di[d];
                int nj = p[1] + dj[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n &&
                    gridA[ni][nj] >= '0' && gridA[ni][nj] <= '9' && dist[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    dist[ni][nj] = dist[p[0]][p[1]] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (dist[i][j] == -1)
                    dist[i][j] = T;

        // Compute reachability
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (gridA[i][j] >= '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9')
                    computeReach(i, j);

        // Build graph
        G = new ArrayList<>();
        G.add(new ArrayList<>()); // node 0 (sink)
        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++)
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++)
                if (gridA[i1][j1] > '0' && gridA[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int k = G.size();
                    G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    E[k] = gridA[i1][j1] - '0';
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                            if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9')
                                if (reach[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                    int _k;
                                    if (nodeB[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                        _k = G.size();
                                        G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                        nodeB[i2][j2] = _k;
                                    } else {
                                        _k = nodeB[i2][j2];
                                    }
                                    G.get(k).add(_k);
                                    G.get(_k).add(k);
                                    C[k][_k] = 10000;
                                    C[_k][k] = 0;
                                }
                }
        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++)
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++)
                if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9' && nodeB[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int _k = nodeB[i2][j2];
                    G.get(_k).add(0);
                    C[_k][0] = gridB[i2][j2] - '0';
                    C[0][_k] = 0;
                }

        // Push-relabel (same as variant 1)
        while (true) {
            boolean ff = true;
            for (int i = 1; i < G.size(); i++) {
                while (E[i] > 0) {
                    boolean f = true;
                    int minH = 10000;
                    for (int _j = 0; _j < G.get(i).size(); _j++) {
                        int j = G.get(i).get(_j);
                        if (C[i][j] - F[i][j] > 0) minH = Math.min(minH, H[j]);
                        if (C[i][j] - F[i][j] > 0 && H[i] == H[j] + 1) {
                            int d = Math.min(C[i][j] - F[i][j], E[i]);
                            F[i][j] += d;
                            F[j][i] -= d;
                            E[i] -= d;
                            E[j] += d;
                            f = false;
                            ff = false;
                            if (E[i] == 0) break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (E[i] == 0) break;
                    if (H[i] != minH + 1 && minH != 10000) {
                        f = false;
                        ff = false;
                        H[i] = minH + 1;
                    }
                    if (f) break;
                }
            }
            if (ff) break;
        }

        System.out.println(E[0]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
